transcript: There is no IPA for SLD as it is an acronym.
definitions: Specific Learning Difficulty: a neurological condition that affects a person's ability to learn in a typical way, often impacting reading, writing, or maths.
Single Lens Reflex: a type of camera that uses a mirror and prism system to allow the photographer to see exactly what will be captured through the lens.
examples: Many students with SLD benefit from tailored educational support.
He bought a new SLD camera for his photography hobby.
